name: a crown shard
text: A shard of a gold crown, too heavy for its size. Inside the rim, in letters older than any you know: 'Given to the King Under the Hill, that the hill may answer him.'
scholar_restore: A king under the hill! Then the old songs were true. Every piece you bring me, the hill remembers a little more.
scholar_bury: You shut it away? It was a crown. A crown, and you gave it back to the dark.
keeper_restore: You carried it up into the light. I hope you know what you are waking.
keeper_bury: Good. Some crowns are better left on dead heads.

name: a bronze seal
text: A royal seal. Its face shows a hill with an eye in it. The wax still on it is warm, though no one has sealed a letter here in a thousand years.
scholar_restore: The eye in the hill... it was not a symbol. It was a promise.
scholar_bury: Another piece sealed away. You are making my work very short.
keeper_restore: The eye opens wider each time. Do you not feel it watching the camp?
keeper_bury: The eye closes. Sleep, old thing.

name: a stone tablet
text: A tablet of laws, cut in a hand that never trembled. The last law is cut deeper than the others: 'When the hill sleeps, none shall wake it.'
scholar_restore: Laws for a kingdom that could move the ground itself! Set it here, gently.
scholar_bury: You buried the law that said not to wake it. Fitting, I suppose.
keeper_restore: You read the last law, I hope, before you brought it up here.
keeper_bury: They wrote that law for people like our scholar. Thank you.

name: a chronicle page
text: A page of the court chronicle: 'The King bade the hill rise against the river people. The hill rose. Then it would not lie down again, and the King was the first it buried.'
scholar_restore: Whatever happened to the king, the power was real. Imagine it answering us instead.
scholar_bury: You read the page and still chose the dark. I cannot argue with that.
keeper_restore: The hill buried its own king. Remember that when it wakes for you.
keeper_bury: Now you understand why I keep this camp. Someone has to remember.

name: the heart stone
text: A stone that beats, slowly, like a sleeping heart. The halls lean toward it. When you hold it, you feel the whole hill draw a breath.
scholar_restore: The heart of the hill. Listen... it beats with us now.
scholar_bury: The heart is sealed. I will never know what it could have done.
keeper_restore: It beats. Up here. In the open. May we all be forgiven.
keeper_bury: It sleeps. And it will keep sleeping, as long as this camp stands.
